questions.stem: Why do gametes (sex cells) contain only 23 chromosomes instead of 46?

options.text: Because gametes do not need DNA
Because gametes are smaller than body cells
Because gametes are produced by mitosis
So that when two gametes fuse at fertilisation, the resulting zygote has the correct 46 chromosomes

questions.explanation: Gametes are haploid (23 chromosomes) so that when two gametes fuse during fertilisation, the resulting zygote is diploid with the full 46 chromosomes, maintaining the correct chromosome number for the species.
